qualifier: chaperone induction, translation control and apoptosis
name: ER unfolded protein response with chaperone induction and apoptosis
rationale: All members are arms or outputs of the ER stress response (ATF6/XBP1/CREB3 chaperone induction, PERK/ATF4 translation control, ER-stress and beta-cell apoptosis), distinguishing it from confusables built on mitochondrial UPR and HRI/GCN2 integrated stress signaling.

name: Short-chain acyl-CoA, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members are small mitochondrial/peroxisomal metabolite pathways feeding or using short/medium acyl-CoAs (threonine, isoleucine, malonyl-, succinyl-, pristanoyl-CoA) plus choline and carnitine synthesis/catabolism, unlike confusables centred on alpha-oxidation, BCAA/cobalamin/TCA disorders or gluconeogenesis.

name: T-helper 1 cell differentiation and effector function
rationale: Members describe CD4 T cell fate decisions centred on Th1 differentiation, IL-12-driven STAT signaling and Th1 cytokine output (with Treg and memory fate), whereas confusables add the antigen-presenting-cell side (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF production, IFN-gamma response).

qualifier: late endosome, multivesicular body and autophagosome
name: Late endosome and autophagosome fusion with lysosome
rationale: All members are terminal fusion/transport steps delivering late endosomes, MVBs and autophagosomes to the lysosome, distinct from confusables on Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis and autophagosome assembly regulation.

name: Cullin-RING ligase degradation regulated by neddylation
rationale: Members are cullin-RING ligase ubiquitination of substrates (PD-L1, NRF2, DVL, AURKA, NOTCH4) together with neddylation/deneddylation and COP9 assembly, which confusables built on RHOBTB cycles, AMPK-ERAD and protein stabilization lack.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and steroidogenic P450 defects
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, gluco- and mineralocorticoid synthesis with CYP11A1/11B1/11B2/17A1/21A2 deficiencies, distinguishing it from confusables on androgen/estrogen synthesis and aldosterone/cortisol regulatory terms.

name: Iron, copper, manganese and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern uptake, transport, detoxification and homeostasis of iron/heme, copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt, whereas confusables are zinc-centred or about HMOX1/metal-responsive transcription.

name: Cardiac contractility and relaxation via calcium sequestration
rationale: Members regulate cardiac contraction force, relaxation and membrane potential through sequestered calcium and ion homeostasis, unlike confusables centred on heart-rate control, sodium/calcium exchange or ryanodine-channel release.

qualifier: regulatory T cell differentiation and tolerance
name: CD4 T cell activation, Treg differentiation and tolerance
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output with emphasis on Treg differentiation, tolerance induction and activation-induced death, distinguished from confusables on Th1 positive effector, other cytokine repression or NK-cell cytotoxicity.

qualifier: N- and O-glycan antennae, blood group antigens
name: N- and O-glycan elongation and terminal capping
rationale: Members build and cap protein-linked glycans (complex/hybrid N-glycans, O-GalNAc glycans, sialylation, fucosylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, poly-LacNAc), whereas confusables cover nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis and transport.

name: Antiviral type I interferon response via RIG-I-like sensing
rationale: Members span virus sensing through RIG-I/MDA5, TRAF3/TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, ISG15 and interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors, distinct from confusables adding endosomal TLR7/8/9, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-gamma responses.

name: Opsin phototransduction cascade activation and recovery
rationale: Members are light absorption by opsins, cascade activation/inactivation and cone-opsin or SLC24A1 defects, unlike confusables on the retinoid cycle or photoreceptor development.

name: Toll-like receptor TRAF6-TAK1 signaling to NF-kB and JNK
rationale: Members are TLR/IRAK/TRIF-driven TRAF6-TAK1 and RIP1-IKK steps activating canonical NF-kB, JNK and p38, distinguished from confusables on TBK1-IRF3, TLR cytokine regulation and non-canonical NF-kB/TNFR1 signaling.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and vascular permeability
rationale: Members concern NOSTRIN/NOSIP-mediated eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven permeability in endothelium, whereas confusables cover NO-cGMP signaling and vascular smooth muscle tone.

name: Leloir galactose and pentose/xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members cover Leloir galactose catabolism and its defects plus non-oxidative pentose phosphate, glucuronate and xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism, which fructose/alditol/glycerol confusables lack.

name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target translation
rationale: Members regulate pri/pre-miRNA processing and miRNA degradation and miRNA control of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), distinct from confusables on core miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC silencing and mRNA deadenylation.

name: Purine ribonucleotide de novo synthesis and salvage
rationale: Members are PRPP, IMP/AMP/GMP de novo synthesis and HPRT/APRT purine salvage, unlike confusables on purine catabolism, deoxynucleotide metabolism or pyrimidine synthesis.

name: Intramembrane cleavage signaling by NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4
rationale: Members are receptor processing and intracellular-domain release for NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4, while confusables centre on NOTCH1 activation, its oncogenic mutants and Notch target transcription.

name: Chemosensory perception, chiefly taste modalities
rationale: Members are taste perception across sweet, bitter, umami, sour and salty with class C receptors plus general smell perception, distinct from confusables built on olfactory receptor expression, pheromone response and TRP/pH channels.

qualifier: TBK1-IRF3 regulation by nucleic acid sensors
name: Regulation of TBK1-IRF3-driven type I interferon production
rationale: Members regulate IRF3/TBK1 induction of IFN-alpha/beta downstream of RIG-I, MDA5, TLR3 and cGAS-STING, a narrower regulatory core than confusables that add broad antiviral, NF-kB, ZBP1 and chemokine pathways.

name: Presynaptic choline uptake and acetylcholine release
rationale: Members concern SLC5A7 choline transport and its defects, acetylcholine synthesis/secretion and neuromuscular cholinergic transmission, distinct from confusables on nicotinic receptors, other neurotransmitter transporters or NMJ assembly.

name: Mucosal antibacterial agglutination and microbe lysis
rationale: Members describe mucosal innate defense by bacterial agglutination and lysis of microbes, whereas confusables cover defensins, metal sequestration and neutrophil respiratory-burst killing.

qualifier: kinesin motors and ER tubule shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin/RHOT-dependent transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in neurons plus ER tubular network and endolysosome size control, distinct from confusables on tubulin modification and ER contact-site lipid transfer.

name: Sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern thick/thin filament organization, myofibril assembly and striated muscle contraction in differentiated fibres, whereas confusables focus on myoblast commitment, proliferation, regeneration or neuromuscular junction assembly.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing, degradation and calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members are mitochondrial peptidase processing and protein degradation including SMDT1 processing that tunes mitochondrial calcium import, distinct from confusables on protein import, cristae formation and respiratory chain assembly.
